{{Top|leg}}
The '''''zaviir-juna''''' was a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] ritual that was needed for a member of the [[Species/Legends|species]] to proceed to the path of the [[Findsman/Legends|findsman]]. This involved the hunting of the greatest findsman of all, namely the [[Zaviir]]. The ritual was noted for being a solitary one and must be completed by the prospective Gand findsman alone, without any aid from others.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]] informed the new [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Havoc Squad]] that he needed to perform the ''zaviir-juna'' at the earliest opportunity.<ref name="Tor">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
